SmartTransit

A commuter assistance & resource‑recovery app built around Kerala's daily bus network — live tracking, an instant ticket scanner, and a complaint system that actually reaches the conductor.

The commute today

Every route still runs on guesswork.

Passengers wait at the stop without knowing if the next bus is already full, delayed, or broken down. A lost bag rarely finds its way back. And when something does go wrong, there's no direct line to the one person who can actually help — the conductor on board. SmartTransit is built to close that loop, stop by stop.

No visibility

Riders can't see load, delays, or breakdowns before they commit to a stop.

No feedback loop

Complaints and lost items get reported into a void, with no read‑receipt or resolution trail.

No quick access

Getting a conductor's attention or checking a ticket dashboard takes far more taps than it should.

Core features

Three systems, one ride.

Everything a commuter needs before, during, and after the journey — designed to feel like a single continuous trip rather than three separate apps.

01 / Navigation

Live Tracking & Navigation

Real‑time Google Maps integration showing nearby buses, routes, and ETAs — before you've even left the house.

  • Live location of every tracked bus on your route
  • Load status flags for overcrowding or breakdowns
  • ETA that updates as traffic changes
02 / Boarding

Quick‑Action Scanner

A built‑in QR / ticket scanner that opens straight into your dashboard — no menu‑hunting, no separate app.

  • Scan a ticket or stop code to open the live dashboard
  • One tap into trip details, route map, and support
  • Works as the front door to every other feature
03 / Support

Smart Complaint & Lost‑and‑Found

Report an issue or a bag left behind, and it goes straight to the specific conductor's app — not a queue.

  • Instant push notification to the conductor on that bus
  • Pending / Seen read‑receipts, plus emergency contact access
  • You confirm once the issue is actually resolved

Route network, visualized
The network, mapped

One line for every route across the city.

SmartTransit's live map borrows the clarity of a transit diagram — every KSRTC route reduced to a clean line, every stop a node you can tap for real‑time status. This clip is a concept visualization of that network, adapted from Wildbeez's KSRTC explainer footage.

Route‑line UI Tap‑to‑expand stops City‑wide coverage
City circular coverage

From the first bus to the last stop, always in view.

Thiruvananthapuram's city‑circular services set the model: a dense web of routes that only works if riders can actually see it move. SmartTransit keeps that whole picture live, one tap away.

Always‑on status

Positions refresh continuously while the app is open

Every circular in frame

City, town, and suburban routes on one map

A conductor a tap away

Complaints and lost items reach the right bus, directly
Built with

A light stack for a heavy commute.

Chosen for speed of iteration as a student project — cross‑platform on the front end, managed services on the back.

Flutter

Single codebase front end for the passenger and conductor apps, on both Android and iOS.

Firebase / Node.js

Real‑time database and push notifications, backed by a Node.js layer for custom logic.

Google Maps API

Live positioning, routing, and ETA calculation for every tracked bus on the network.

Next stop

Built for a smoother ride, from Thiruvananthapuram outward.

A concept project for KSRTC's daily commuters — live tracking, a faster scanner, and a complaint system that actually gets seen.
